concepts.label: Octagon means stop
concepts.statement: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign: you must stop completely and give the right-of-way to pedestrians and all cross traffic before moving again.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These eight-sided signs are reserved for stop signs.  These signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and to all cross traffi  c before moving again.

concepts.label: Where to stop at a stop sign
concepts.statement: Stop behind the marked or unmarked crosswalk, or before entering the intersection if there are no markings, at a place where you can see traffic from all directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: At a stop sign, you must stop behind any marked or unmarked crosswalk (joining sidewalks on opposite sides of the street).  If there are no pavement markings or cross walks, you must stop before entering an intersection.

concepts.label: Upside-down triangle means yield
concepts.statement: A downward-pointing triangle is a yield sign, which requires you to yield the right-of-way to cross traffic or to merging traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (upside down)
source.sourceQuote: This shape requires that you yield the right-of-way to cross traffi  c or to merging traffi  c.

concepts.label: Pennant marks a no-passing zone
concepts.statement: A pennant-shaped sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

concepts.label: Pentagon means school zone
concepts.statement: A five-sided sign warns of a school zone ahead or marks a school crossing, where the maximum speed limit is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specified.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: The maximum speed limit in a school zone is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specifi ed.

concepts.label: Upright triangle marks a slow-moving vehicle
concepts.statement: A right-side-up triangle with a reflective red border and fluorescent orange centre identifies a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle that has made an emergency stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (right side up)
source.sourceQuote: A right side up triangular sign with a refl ective red border and fl uorescent orange center identifi es a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle which has made an emergency stop.

concepts.label: Regulatory sign colours
concepts.statement: Most regulatory signs are white with black letters, and the sign is red with white letters when the message is very important.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most signs are white with black letters. When the message is very important, the sign is red with white letters.

concepts.label: A red slash always means NO
concepts.statement: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO — whatever is pictured inside is prohibited.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

concepts.label: Speed limit and advisory speed signs
concepts.statement: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed allowed under optimal weather and road conditions, while black-on-yellow advisory signs show a recommended safe speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

concepts.label: Yellow diamond warns of danger ahead
concepts.statement: Diamond-shaped warning signs are yellow with black letters, usually appear without explanatory words, and warn of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

concepts.label: Yellow-green pedestrian and school warnings
concepts.statement: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters rather than yellow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

concepts.label: Orange is the work-zone colour
concepts.statement: Orange is the basic colour for work-zone traffic control devices, which warn of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

concepts.label: Guide sign colours
concepts.statement: Most guide signs are white on green, motorist services signs are white on blue, and park and recreation signs are white on brown.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

concepts.label: Railroad crossing signs
concepts.statement: Railroad crossing signs may be round or diamond-shaped yellow signs with black symbols, or black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

concepts.label: You must yield to all trains
concepts.statement: You must yield to all trains, and failing to stop when the lights are flashing or a barrier is down will result in a citation.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

concepts.label: Never enter a crossing you cannot clear
concepts.statement: Do not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks, or you may be trapped on them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

concepts.label: Circular green
concepts.statement: On a circular green you may enter the intersection and go straight, right or left unless signs or markings prohibit the movement, and a left turn must yield to oncoming vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing this signal may enter the intersection and go straight through, turn right, or left, unless, other traffi  c control devices (signs or pavement markings) prohibit certain movements.

concepts.label: Green arrow
concepts.statement: A green arrow allows you to make the movement the arrow shows, and in a left-turn signal it usually means opposing traffic is stopped.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A green arrow may be shown alone or with other indications.  Drivers facing the signal may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

concepts.label: Steady yellow
concepts.statement: A steady yellow means the green is ending and will change to red, and you should only drive through it if your vehicle is already within the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

concepts.label: Steady red
concepts.statement: Traffic facing a steady circular red must stop and remain stopped until another indication allows it to proceed, unless a green arrow permits the movement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

concepts.label: Turning on red
concepts.statement: After a complete stop and yielding to all other traffic and pedestrians, you may turn right on red at two-way streets, or left on red from a one-way street onto another one-way street, unless signs prohibit it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

concepts.label: Flashing red and flashing yellow
concepts.statement: A circular flashing red is the same as a stop sign, while a circular flashing yellow lets you proceed through the intersection with caution.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A circular fl ashing red is the same as a stop sign; that is, drivers must come to

concepts.label: WALK and DON'T WALK signals
concepts.statement: Crosswalk signals are traffic signals for pedestrians and must be obeyed: the hand or DON'T WALK means do not cross, and the walking man or WALK means it is safe to cross inside the lines.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Crosswalk signals are traffi  c signals for pedestrians.  If these signals are in place, pedestrians are to obey them.

concepts.label: Blind pedestrians always have the right-of-way
concepts.statement: A blind person on foot using a guide dog or service animal, or carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way whether or not they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

concepts.label: White lines versus yellow lines
concepts.statement: White lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction, and yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: WHITE lines separate traffic lanes moving in the SAME direction.

concepts.label: Broken yellow line
concepts.statement: A broken yellow line on your side of the road means you may pass when it is safe to do so.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.  If this marking is on your side of the road, you may pass when it is safe.

concepts.label: Solid yellow line
concepts.statement: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you must not pass.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

concepts.label: Broken and solid white lines
concepts.statement: Broken white lines separate same-direction lanes and must not be straddled except when changing lanes, while solid white lines mark the pavement edge and forbid lane changes where they separate same-direction lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: On roadways which have more than one (1) lane moving in one direction, traffic lanes are separated by broken white lines.

concepts.label: Diamond lanes
concepts.statement: White diamond shapes painted in a lane mean it is designated for car pools, bicycles or buses.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: White diamond shapes painted in the roadway to inform drivers the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles, or buses.

concepts.label: Centre left-turn lane
concepts.statement: A centre left-turn lane is reserved for left turns from either direction and must never be used as a through or passing lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

concepts.label: Stop lines and crosswalk lines
concepts.statement: A wide white stop line marks where you must stop, and where there is no stop line or crosswalk you must stop before entering the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Stop Lines - Wide white lines, painted across traffic lanes, mark where you must stop your vehicle at intersections.

concepts.label: Reasonable and prudent for conditions
concepts.statement: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent for existing conditions, even when the posted limit is higher.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed that is greater than reasonable and prudent for existing conditions.

concepts.label: Designated speed limits
concepts.statement: Unless otherwise posted, the designated limits are 70 mph on interstates, 55 mph on open county highways, 25 mph in business or residential areas, and 15 mph in a school zone while children are present.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Interstate - Maximum Speed 70mph unless otherwise posted

concepts.label: What counts as a school zone
concepts.statement: A school zone is all school property plus any abutting street or highway, extending 125 feet along that street or highway from the school grounds.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: A school zone is all school property, including school grounds, and/or any street or highway abutting the school grounds and extending 125 feet along the street or highway from the school grounds.

concepts.label: Signal at least 100 feet ahead
concepts.statement: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn, and signal every time you change lanes, turn, enter or leave an interstate, or pull away from or over to the curb.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Get into the habit of signaling every time you make a change.  Signal at least 100 feet before you plan to turn.

concepts.label: Slow before the turn, finish in the proper lane
concepts.statement: Slow down before making a turn rather than braking while turning, and always finish the turn in the proper lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Slow down before making turns.  Do not brake while turning.

concepts.label: Keep the wheels straight waiting to turn left
concepts.statement: While waiting to turn left, do not turn your wheels to the left, because a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When waiting to turn left, do not turn the wheels to the left.  Otherwise, a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffi  c.

concepts.label: Where turning around is illegal
concepts.statement: It is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve or near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by a vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs prohibit turning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: it is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve, near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by another vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs  prohibit turning.

concepts.label: Backing up safely
concepts.statement: Before backing, check completely around the vehicle, keep looking to the rear while backing instead of depending on the mirror, and never back across traffic lanes or through an intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Before backing, check completely around your vehicle for people and/or other obstacles.  You should look to the front, sides and rear and continue to look to the rear while backing. Do not depend on your mirror.

concepts.label: Direction of parking and securing the vehicle
concepts.statement: Park facing the same direction as traffic moves on that side of the street, and whenever you leave the vehicle turn off the engine and set the parking brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Vehicles must always be parked in the same direction as the movement of traffi  c on that side of the street.

concepts.label: Prohibited parking distances
concepts.statement: Parking is prohibited within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection, 30 feet of a stop sign or traffic signal, and 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)
source.sourceQuote: Within 15 feet of a fi re hydrant

concepts.label: Parking on a grade
concepts.statement: When you park or stop on a grade, turn the front wheels to the curb side of the highway so the vehicle will not roll, and set the emergency or parking brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If you park or stop on a grade, turn the front wheels to the curb side of the highway so the vehicle will not roll.  Be sure to set the emergency or parking brake.

concepts.label: Parallel parking distance
concepts.statement: A parallel parked vehicle must have its wheels within 18 inches of the curb and must face the direction of traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Parallel Parking (§17C-13-4, W. Va. State Code)
source.sourceQuote: When parallel parking on the left side of the road, wheels should be within 18 inches of the left curb.  Park in the direction of the traffic.

concepts.label: The three-to-four second rule
concepts.statement: Pick a fixed object ahead, and if you reach it before finishing the count of one thousand three after the vehicle ahead passes it, you are following too closely.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: To use the three-to-four second rule, choose a fixed object on the road ahead (such as a signpost, tree, overpass, or bridge abutment).  When the vehicle ahead passes that object, begin to count “one thousand one, one thousand two, one thousand three.”

concepts.label: More seconds in bad conditions
concepts.statement: Following distance should be at least four seconds when it is dark or raining, and at least six seconds on ice or snow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If it is dark or raining, the distance should be at least four seconds.

concepts.label: How to change lanes
concepts.statement: Check the mirrors, make a head check over your shoulder for the blind spot, watch for other drivers moving into the same lane, then signal and change lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Check over your left or right shoulder (head check) to make sure no one is in your blind spot.

concepts.label: Finishing a pass
concepts.statement: Signal and return to the proper lane once you can see the front of the passed vehicle — both headlights — in your rear view mirror, and do not pass on the right unless a lane is designated for passing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Signal and return to the proper lane when you see the front of the vehicle (both headlights) you have passed in your rear view mirror. Passing on the right is not permissible unless there is a lane designated for passing.

concepts.label: Where passing is prohibited
concepts.statement: Passing is prohibited on a curve or hill where you cannot see oncoming traffic, within 100 feet of an intersection, bridge, viaduct, tunnel, underpass or railroad crossing, and when a solid yellow line is in your lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Passing is PROHIBITED in the following places
source.sourceQuote: On a curve or hill or at any place where you cannot see oncoming traffic.

concepts.label: Right-of-way is given, not taken
concepts.statement: Right-of-way is something to be given rather than taken, so yield even when the rules are on your side if another driver does not follow them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Remember, in every situation, right-of-way is something to be given, not taken.

concepts.label: Entering a road from a driveway or alley
concepts.statement: When entering a public street or highway from an alley, private road or driveway, you must yield to traffic already on the roadway.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When entering a public street or highway from an alley, private road, or driveway, you must yield to traffic already on the roadway.

concepts.label: Arriving at the same time
concepts.statement: At uncontrolled intersections and four-way stops, if you reach the intersection at the same time as another vehicle you yield to the driver on the right.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Uncontrolled intersections and four-way stop intersections - If you reach the intersection at the same time as another vehicle, yield to the driver on the right.

concepts.label: Left turns yield to oncoming traffic
concepts.statement: When making a left turn you must yield the right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When making a left turn, you must yield the right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

concepts.label: Emergency vehicles
concepts.statement: Yield to any emergency vehicle sounding a siren and flashing warning lights by pulling over to the right edge of the road, clear of the intersection, and stopping until it has passed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to any emergency vehicle (ambulance, fire, or police vehicle) that is sounding a siren and flashing warning lights. Pull over to the right edge of the road, clear of the intersection, and stop until the emergency vehicle has passed.

concepts.label: Police officers and funeral processions
concepts.statement: A police officer's directions overrule any sign, signal or road marking, and yielding to a funeral procession is a courtesy rather than a legal requirement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Directions of a police officer overrule the message of any sign, signal, or road marking.

concepts.label: When pedestrians have the right of way
concepts.statement: Pedestrians have the right of way in a crosswalk, when crossing a sidewalk that crosses an alley entrance or driveway, and when blind and using a cane or guide dog.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: They are crossing a sidewalk that crosses an alley entrance or driveway.

concepts.label: What pedestrians must do
concepts.statement: Pedestrians must use crosswalks at intersections, walk on the left side facing oncoming traffic where there is no sidewalk, and must not walk on interstate highways.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Pedestrians - Pedestrians must
source.sourceQuote: When walking along a road where there is no sidewalk, walk on the left side facing oncoming traffic. Walk on the shoulder of the road, if possible.

concepts.label: Both directions must stop
concepts.statement: On all highways, streets, parking lots, private roads and driveways, traffic in both directions must stop before reaching a school bus with its red lights flashing that is receiving or discharging students.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: On all highways, streets, parking lots, private roads or driveways, traffic in both directions must stop before reaching a school bus that has its red

concepts.label: When you may move again
concepts.statement: You may not proceed until the bus resumes motion, the school bus driver signals you to proceed, or the visual signals are no longer operating.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: proceed until the bus resumes motion, or signaled by the school bus driver to proceed or the visual signals are no longer actuated.

concepts.label: The interstate exception
concepts.statement: Only on interstate highways does traffic coming toward a school bus stopped on the other side of the median not have to stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Only on Interstate Highways does traffic coming toward a school bus stopped on the other side of the median not have to stop.

concepts.label: Penalty for passing a stopped school bus
concepts.statement: A first offence of passing a stopped school bus carries a minimum 60-day driver's license suspension and a minimum $500 fine or confinement in jail for not more than six months.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: The penalty for passing a stopped school bus is a minimum of 60 days driver’s license suspension and a minimum fine of $500 or confinement in jail for not more than six (6) months for the first offense.

concepts.label: Dimming distances
concepts.statement: Dim your headlights within 500 feet of an approaching vehicle and within 200 feet of the vehicle in front of you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Dim your headlights within 500 feet of an approaching vehicle.

concepts.label: When headlights must be on
concepts.statement: Turn on your headlights from sunset to sunrise, during fog, smoke or rain, and any other time people and vehicles cannot be seen clearly at 500 feet.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Turn on your headlights from sunset to sunrise, during fog, smoke, rain, or at any other time when persons and vehicles cannot be seen clearly at a distance of 500 feet.

concepts.label: Dealing with a tailgater
concepts.statement: If a vehicle follows too closely, tap your brakes gently to flash the brake lights, slow down to encourage it to pass, and if that fails pull over and let it by.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Tap your brakes gently to flash the brake lights and warn the tailgater.

concepts.label: A motorcycle is entitled to the whole lane
concepts.statement: Motorcyclists are entitled to and need the entire lane, so expect them to move around in it and keep a minimum three-to-four second following distance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Motorcyclists are entitled to and will need the entire lane to maneuver around possible hazards and traffic situations.  It is wise to keep a safe minimum three -to-four second following distance.

concepts.label: Following and passing a motorcycle
concepts.statement: Stay farther back than you would behind a car because a motorcycle can stop much faster, and when passing go all the way into the other lane and wait until well down the road before returning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Stay farther back than if you were behind a vehicle.  The motorcycle can usually slow or stop much faster than you can.  When passing, go all the way into the other lane.

concepts.label: Trucks need far more room to stop
concepts.statement: A fully loaded tractor-trailer travelling 55 mph needs three times the distance a car needs to stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Heavy Trucks
source.sourceQuote: A fully loaded tractor-trailer, traveling 55 mph, needs three (3) times the distance a vehicle needs to stop.

concepts.label: The No-Zone
concepts.statement: A truck's blind spots, called the No-Zone, are dangerous because the driver cannot see you there, and if you cannot see the driver's reflection in the side mirror you are in one.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: The easiest way to avoid lingering in the “No-Zone” is to look for the truck driver’s reflection in the side mirror. If you cannot see the driver’s reflection, you are in the truck driver’s blind spot.

concepts.label: Merging back in front of a truck
concepts.statement: After passing a truck, allow two seconds before merging back in dry conditions, and four to six seconds of space in wet conditions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: In dry conditions use the two-second rule. After passing give two (2) seconds before merging to the right.

concepts.label: Passing a bicyclist
concepts.statement: When passing a bicyclist, slow down, make sure they are aware of you and leave plenty of room, and if there is no room while traffic is approaching, wait.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When passing a bicyclist, slow down, make sure they are aware of you, and leave plenty of room between him or her and your vehicle.  If there is no room to pass and traffic is approaching, wait until traffic has gone by before passing.

concepts.label: Bicyclists follow the same rules
concepts.statement: Bicyclists must obey the same rules of the road as other drivers, ride in the same direction as traffic, and yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Obey the same rules of the road as drivers of other vehicles.

concepts.label: Required bicycle equipment
concepts.statement: A bicycle needs a red rear reflector, brakes able to stop one wheel on dry level pavement, a bell audible at 100 feet, and after dark a white headlight visible at 500 feet.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Bell or other device capable of giving a signal audible for a distance of at least 100 feet

concepts.label: Horses and animal riders
concepts.statement: Animal riders may use most public highways but not interstates, have the same rights and duties as drivers, and you must never sound your horn near a horse.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Animal Riders
source.sourceQuote: Animal riders may use most public highways, but they may not use interstate highways.  Persons riding animals have the same rights as  motor vehicle users and are subject to the same rules.

concepts.label: Public buses and children at play
concepts.statement: Traffic does not have to stop for a public bus but must watch for passengers crossing, and drivers must be extra careful wherever children are likely to be.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Public Buses
source.sourceQuote: While traffic does not have to stop for a public bus, please watch for passengers crossing the street as they are getting on and off the bus.

lessons.title: Read the Shape Before You Read the Words

rules.text: An eight-sided (octagon) sign is always a stop sign, and it means stop completely and give the right-of-way to pedestrians and all cross traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These eight-sided signs are reserved for stop signs.  These signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and to all cross traffi  c before moving again.

rules.text: Stop behind the marked or unmarked crosswalk; with no markings, stop before entering the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: At a stop sign, you must stop behind any marked or unmarked crosswalk (joining sidewalks on opposite sides of the street).  If there are no pavement markings or cross walks, you must stop before entering an intersection.

rules.text: Stop where you can see traffic coming from all directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Stop at a place where you can see traffi  c coming from all directions.

rules.text: An upside-down triangle means yield the right-of-way to cross traffic or merging traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (upside down)
source.sourceQuote: This shape requires that you yield the right-of-way to cross traffi  c or to merging traffi  c.

rules.text: A pennant marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

rules.text: A round yellow-and-black sign gives advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This yellow-and-black sign gives advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.

rules.text: A pentagon warns of a school zone ahead or marks a school crossing, where the limit is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specified.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: The maximum speed limit in a school zone is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specifi ed.

rules.text: A right-side-up triangle with a reflective red border and fluorescent orange centre marks a slow moving vehicle or one that has made an emergency stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (right side up)
source.sourceQuote: A right side up triangular sign with a refl ective red border and fl uorescent orange center identifi es a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle which has made an emergency stop.

rules.text: Shape and colour carry meaning so a sign can be recognised when light, fog, rain, snow or darkness hide the letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: The shape and color of signs have meaning.  If fading light, fog, rain, snow, or darkness make it diffi  cult to see the letters, applicants should still know how to recognize a sign and respond accordingly.

lessons.plainEnglish: West Virginia reserves a unique outline for each of a handful of critical messages. Octagon is stop, upside-down triangle is yield, pennant is no passing, circle is a railroad warning, pentagon is a school zone, and an upright orange triangle is a slow vehicle. Nothing else uses those shapes.
lessons.whyItMatters: On a foggy night or behind a salt-crusted windscreen the lettering may be unreadable long before the outline is. The handbook expects you to identify and obey the sign from its silhouette alone, and permit tests lean heavily on shape-to-meaning recall.
lessons.example: You crest a hill at dusk in heavy rain and can only make out a five-sided outline at the roadside. Without reading a word you should already be braking toward 15 m.p.h. and scanning for children, because only a school zone sign is a pentagon.

lessons.title: Regulatory Signs Tell You the Law

rules.text: Square and rectangular signs show traffic regulations and guide your speed and direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These signs show traffi  c regulations and guide your speed and direction. These signs tell you about speed limits and other traffi  c laws.

rules.text: Most signs are white with black letters; when the message is very important the sign is red with white letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most signs are white with black letters. When the message is very important, the sign is red with white letters.

rules.text: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

rules.text: Speed limit signs show the fastest speed you may drive under optimal weather and road conditions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

rules.text: Advisory speed signs at interstate entrance and exit ramps are black on yellow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These advisory signs are black on yellow.

lessons.plainEnglish: Squares and rectangles carry the rules. White with black letters is the everyday regulatory sign; red with white letters is reserved for the messages that matter most; and any red circle with a slash through it forbids whatever is drawn inside.
lessons.whyItMatters: Regulatory signs are enforceable law, not advice. Confusing a black-on-yellow advisory speed with a posted white-and-black limit, or missing a red slash, is how drivers pick up citations they thought they were obeying.
lessons.example: A white rectangle reads SPEED LIMIT 55 on a dry clear day, but the ramp ahead carries a black-on-yellow 35. The 55 is the law for the highway under ideal conditions; the 35 is the recommended safe speed for the curve of the ramp, and taking the ramp at 55 is exactly how vehicles roll over.

lessons.title: Yellow Diamonds Warn You Early

rules.text: Diamond-shaped warning signs usually appear without explanatory words beneath them, are yellow with black letters, and warn of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

rules.text: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

rules.text: Most warning signs are seen without identifying text and instead often have pictures.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: The shapes and colors of signs are a very helpful indicator as to what they are trying to tell you.

lessons.plainEnglish: A yellow diamond says something ahead needs your attention: a curve, a crossroad, a merging lane, a hill, a low bridge, a slippery stretch, a crosswalk or a signal. The symbol tells you which. Pedestrian and school warnings may use a brighter yellow-green.
lessons.whyItMatters: Warning signs are placed far enough ahead that you can still act. A driver who registers the diamond but does not slow until they see the hazard has already given away the margin the sign was designed to buy.
lessons.example: A yellow diamond with a squiggly arrow appears on a rural road you have never driven. There is no advisory plate, so you have no number to obey — but the sign is telling you that the curve cannot be taken at the regular highway speed, so you come off the accelerator before you enter it.

lessons.title: Orange Means People Are Working

rules.text: Construction and maintenance signs notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Construction and maintenance signs are used to notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

rules.text: The commonly used work-zone devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, flashing arrow panels and flaggers, and orange is their basic colour.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

rules.text: Large flashing or sequencing arrow panels guide drivers into certain lanes and tell them part of the road ahead is closed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs - Flashing Arrow Panels
source.sourceQuote: Large fl ashing or sequencing arrow panels may be used in work zones both day and night to guide drivers into certain traffi  c lanes and to inform them that part of the road or street ahead of them is closed.

rules.text: Flaggers wear orange vests, shirts or jackets and use red-orange flags or stop/slow paddles to direct traffic through work zones.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Flaggers wear orange vests, shirts, or jackets and use red-orange fl ags or stop/slow paddles to direct traffi  c through work zones.

lessons.plainEnglish: In a work zone the colour changes from yellow to orange, and the devices change from signs alone to barricades, drums, cones, arrow panels and people. A flagger's paddle carries the same authority as a sign.
lessons.whyItMatters: Work zones put people on foot a few feet from live traffic, and the layout can change between one trip and the next. The orange colour is your cue that what you learned about this stretch of road yesterday may not be true today.
lessons.example: A flashing arrow panel points left half a mile ahead of a lane closure, and a flagger in an orange vest holds a SLOW paddle. You move left early rather than running the closing lane to its end, and you pass the flagger at a speed that would let you stop for a worker stepping out.

lessons.title: Guide Signs Answer Where and How Far

rules.text: Guide signs tell you where you are, what road you are on, and how to get where you want to go.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These signs tell you WHERE you are, WHAT road you are on, and HOW to get where you want to go.

rules.text: Most guide signs are white on green, motorist services signs are white on blue, and park and recreation signs are white on brown.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

rules.text: WV and U.S. route markers are generally black on white.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: WV & U.S. Route Markers - Are generally black on white.

rules.text: Interstate markers are red, white and blue.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Interstate markers -  Are red, white, and blue..

lessons.plainEnglish: Green is navigation, blue is services such as fuel and food, brown is parks and recreation. Route markers identify the road itself: black on white for WV and U.S. routes, red white and blue for interstates.
lessons.whyItMatters: Reading guide signs early is what keeps you from a last-second lane change across three lanes at an exit — the manoeuvre that causes crashes at interchanges. The colour tells you instantly whether a sign is worth reading now or not at all.
lessons.example: Approaching an interchange you see a green sign for EXIT 99 in one mile and a blue sign listing fuel. The green sign decides your lane; the blue one only decides whether you take the exit at all, so you read the green sign first and move right while there is still room.

lessons.title: At a Crossing, the Train Always Wins

rules.text: Railroad crossing signs may be round or diamond-shaped yellow signs with black symbols, or black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

rules.text: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two or more.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two

rules.text: You must yield to all trains, and failure to stop when lights are flashing or a barrier is down will result in a citation.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

rules.text: Where there are two or more tracks, be alert for a second train on the other set of tracks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When there are two (2) or more tracks, you must be alert for a second train on the other set of tracks.

rules.text: Do not enter a crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks, or you may be trapped and hit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

rules.text: Passing is prohibited within 100 feet of any railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Passing is PROHIBITED in the following places
source.sourceQuote: Within 100 feet of any railroad crossing.

rules.text: Do not change lanes at a railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: DO NOT change lanes in an intersection or at a railroad crossing.

lessons.plainEnglish: The crossbuck is the crossing itself; the round yellow sign is the advance warning. Bells, flashers and gates mean a train is coming, and you must yield to every train, every time. Never move onto the tracks unless there is room for your whole vehicle on the far side.
lessons.whyItMatters: A train cannot stop for you and needs far more distance than any road vehicle. Most crossing deaths involve a vehicle that was on the tracks with nowhere to go, either because traffic ahead had not cleared or because the driver assumed only one train was coming.
lessons.example: Traffic is backed up beyond a crossing at rush hour. The car ahead moves forward but stops with its bumper only two car-lengths past the far rail. You hold behind the crossbuck rather than following it, because if the queue does not move you would be sitting on the rails when the gates come down.

lessons.title: Every Signal Indication Has One Meaning

rules.text: On circular green you may enter the intersection and go straight, right or left unless other devices prohibit the movement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing this signal may enter the intersection and go straight through, turn right, or left, unless, other traffi  c control devices (signs or pavement markings) prohibit certain movements.

rules.text: A driver facing circular green who wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver who is facing a circular green indication and wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

rules.text: A green arrow lets you enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A green arrow may be shown alone or with other indications.  Drivers facing the signal may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

rules.text: A green arrow in a left-turn signal usually means opposing traffic is stopped.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When the green arrow is shown in a left-turn signal, it usually means that opposing traffi  c is stopped.

rules.text: Steady yellow means the green is ending; only drive through it if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

rules.text: A yellow arrow means the green arrow is ending and will change to red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Yellow Arrow / LEFT TURN - This means that the green arrow is ending and will change to red.

rules.text: Traffic facing steady circular red must stop and remain stopped until another indication allows it to proceed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

rules.text: Right on red is allowed at two-way streets and left on red from one-way to one-way, after yielding to all traffic and pedestrians and if no sign prohibits it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

rules.text: A steady red arrow requires a complete stop before the intersection, stop line or crosswalk, and you remain stopped while it is red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Come to a complete stop before reaching the intersection, stop line or cross walk for the direction indicated by the arrow.  Remain stopped as long as the signal is red.

lessons.plainEnglish: Green is permission, not priority — you still yield when turning left. A green arrow is protection, because opposing traffic is normally stopped. Yellow means the phase is ending, and red means stop until something changes, with turn on red as the only exception.
lessons.whyItMatters: Intersections are where the most conflicting paths cross, and signal questions appear on every permit test. The difference between a permissive green ball and a protected green arrow is the difference between yielding and going, and getting it wrong causes head-on left-turn crashes.
lessons.example: You are waiting to turn left on a circular green with two cars coming the other way. The green ball does not give you the intersection — it only lets you into it — so you wait for a gap. If the signal changes to a green arrow, opposing traffic is stopped and the turn is yours.

lessons.title: Flashing Signals and Signals for People

rules.text: Flashers are installed at certain intersections to supplement or replace STOP signs.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: At certain intersections, fl ashers are installed to supplement or replace STOP signs.

rules.text: Drivers facing a circular flashing yellow may proceed through the intersection with caution.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing a circular fl ashing yellow light may proceed through the intersection

rules.text: A circular flashing red is the same as a stop sign, so drivers must come to a complete stop and yield.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A circular fl ashing red is the same as a stop sign; that is, drivers must come to

rules.text: Signals that are not needed or are out of order may be placed in flashing operation, and then mean the same as intersection flashers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When traffi  c control signals are not needed or are out of order, they may be placed in fl ashing operations. When this happens, they are the same as intersection fl ashers.

rules.text: Lane use control signals control traffic where the direction of a street or lane changes during the day.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Special signals are used to control traffi  c when the direction of a street or certain lane changes during the day.  These signals indicate how the specifi c lanes may be used.

rules.text: Crosswalk signals are traffic signals for pedestrians, and pedestrians are to obey them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Crosswalk signals are traffi  c signals for pedestrians.  If these signals are in place, pedestrians are to obey them.

rules.text: A hand symbol or DON'T WALK means pedestrians are not to cross.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Hand Symbol or DON'T WALK- when these appear pedestrians are not to cross the crosswalk.

rules.text: A walking man or WALK means pedestrians are safe to cross inside the crosswalk lines.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Walking Man or WALK - when these appear  pedestrians are safe to cross the street inside the crosswalk lines.

rules.text: A blind person using a guide dog, service animal, white cane or walking stick has the right-of-way whether or not they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

lessons.plainEnglish: Flashing red is a stop sign; flashing yellow is a caution. A dead or unneeded signal put into flashing operation means exactly the same thing. Pedestrian signals govern people on foot, but a blind pedestrian has the right-of-way regardless.
lessons.whyItMatters: A signal that has failed is one of the most dangerous intersections on the road, because drivers on each approach may be reading different indications. Knowing that flashing red equals a stop sign is what keeps a power cut from becoming a broadside collision.
lessons.example: A storm has knocked the signals at a four-way junction into flashing operation: red toward you, yellow across. You stop completely and yield as if at a stop sign, and you do not assume the cross traffic will stop — their flashing yellow lets them roll through with caution.

lessons.title: The Lines Are Instructions Too

rules.text: Pavement markings are used like highway signs to warn, regulate and inform traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Pavement markings are used like highway signs to warn, regulate, and inform traffic.

rules.text: White lines separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: WHITE lines separate traffic lanes moving in the SAME direction.

rules.text: Yellow lines separate traffic lanes moving in opposite directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: YELLOW lines separate traffic lanes moving in the OPPOSITE direction.

rules.text: A broken yellow line on your side means you may pass when it is safe.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.  If this marking is on your side of the road, you may pass when it is safe.

rules.text: A solid yellow line on your side means you MUST NOT PASS.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

rules.text: Broken white lines separate same-direction lanes; drive within them and never straddle them except when changing lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: On roadways which have more than one (1) lane moving in one direction, traffic lanes are separated by broken white lines.

rules.text: Solid white lines mark the pavement edge, and where they separate same-direction lanes, DO NOT CHANGE LANES.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Solid white lines mark the edge of the pavement.  At night or in bad weather, they help you stay on the road.  When solid white lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction, DO NOT CHANGE LANES.

rules.text: White diamonds mark a lane designated for car pools, bicycles or buses.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: White diamond shapes painted in the roadway to inform drivers the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles, or buses.

rules.text: Centre left-turn lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.
