questions.question: A red outline with a diagonal bar through a symbol always means:
choices: The restriction has ended
The action shown is prohibited
The action shown is recommended
Caution, hazard ahead
questions.explanation: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO, so whatever is drawn inside the circle is forbidden.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

questions.question: At an intersection you see a sign showing a left-turn arrow inside a red circle with a diagonal bar across it. What does it tell you?
choices: You may turn left only when the signal shows a green arrow
Left turns are permitted but discouraged here
You may not turn left at that intersection
You may turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic
questions.explanation: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO, so the left turn drawn inside it is prohibited outright rather than merely restricted.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

questions.question: A posted speed limit sign shows:
choices: The speed you must maintain at all times
The average speed of traffic on that road
The minimum legal speed
The fastest speed you may drive under optimal weather and road conditions
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the fastest speed you may drive under optimal weather and road conditions, so poor conditions require a lower speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

questions.question: You see a black-on-yellow speed number on an interstate exit ramp. What is it?
choices: An advisory speed showing the maximum recommended safe speed for the ramp
A regulatory speed limit carrying the same penalty as any other
A minimum speed for the ramp
The speed limit for the road you are joining
questions.explanation: Advisory speed signs are black on yellow and are found at interstate entrances and exit ramps, showing the maximum recommended safe speed for driving on the ramp.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These advisory signs are black on yellow.

questions.question: A yellow diamond-shaped sign with black letters or symbols tells you:
choices: A regulation is in force
You are entering a work zone
Which route you are on
There is possible danger ahead
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs are yellow with black letters and warn of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

questions.question: Which statement about yellow diamond warning signs is NOT correct?
choices: They always carry explanatory words beneath the symbol
They usually appear without explanatory words beneath them
They are yellow with black letters
They may use symbols or written warnings
questions.explanation: The handbook says these signs will usually appear without explanatory words beneath them, which is exactly why the symbol and the diamond shape have to be learned.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

questions.question: Which warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters instead of yellow?
choices: Pedestrian and school warning signs
Railroad crossing signs
Work zone signs
Route markers
questions.explanation: The handbook allows pedestrian and school warning signs to be yellow-green with black letters, a brighter colour chosen for the places people walk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign ahead is yellow-green with a black figure of a person walking. What is it most likely warning of?
choices: A scenic area
A crosswalk or pedestrian path crossing the road
A weight-restricted bridge
A work zone flagger
questions.explanation: Yellow-green with black letters is the colour the handbook gives for pedestrian and school warning signs, and the diamond marks it as a warning of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

questions.subtopic: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
questions.question: What is the basic colour for traffic control devices in construction and maintenance work areas?
choices: Orange
Yellow
Green
Blue
questions.explanation: Orange is the basic colour for work zone devices such as signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, arrow panels and flaggers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

questions.question: The diamond-shaped sign ahead of you is orange rather than yellow. What does the change of colour tell you?
choices: A school zone begins here
You are approaching a construction or maintenance work area
The warning has expired
The sign is a guide sign, not a warning
questions.explanation: Orange is the basic colour for construction and maintenance devices, which notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Construction and maintenance signs are used to notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

questions.subtopic: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed by the handbook as a commonly used work zone traffic control device?
choices: Flashing arrow panels
Cones and tubes
Crossbucks
Barricades and drums
questions.explanation: Crossbucks are railroad crossing signs. The work zone devices listed are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, flashing arrow panels and flaggers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

questions.question: Most guide signs are:
choices: Black on yellow
White on green
White on blue
White on brown
questions.explanation: Most guide signs are white on green; blue is reserved for motorist services and brown for parks and recreation areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

questions.question: You want to know which services are available at the next exit. Which sign colour do you look for?
choices: White on brown
Black on white
White on blue
White on green
questions.explanation: Motorist services signs are white on blue, while green signs handle navigation and brown signs mark parks and recreation areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

questions.question: A white-on-brown sign appears beside the highway. What is it for?
choices: An upcoming rest stop with fuel
A hospital
A construction detour
A park or public recreation area
questions.explanation: Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown, distinguishing them at a glance from green navigation signs and blue service signs.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

questions.question: Black letters on white bars in the shape of an X at a railroad crossing is called a:
choices: Crossbuck
Pennant
Crossbar
Chevron
questions.explanation: The handbook names the X-shaped sign of white bars with black letters a crossbuck; it marks the crossing itself.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

questions.question: What does a sign mounted below the crossbuck tell you?
choices: The distance to the next crossing
The number of tracks, when there are two or more
The speed of approaching trains
The name of the railroad
questions.explanation: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two or more, which is a warning that a second train may be coming on the other set.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a form the handbook gives for railroad crossing signs?
choices: A diamond-shaped yellow sign with black symbols
A white crossbuck with black letters
An orange rectangle with black letters
A round yellow sign with black symbols
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing signs may be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or a white crossbuck with black letters; orange is the work zone colour.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing you must yield to:
choices: Only trains sounding a horn
Trains only when the gate is down
All trains
Only passenger trains
questions.explanation: The rule is unqualified: you must yield to all trains, and a train cannot stop or swerve for you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

questions.question: The lights at a crossing begin flashing but you cannot see a train yet. What happens if you drive across?
choices: Nothing, as long as no train is visible
It is allowed if you first stop
It is allowed if the gates have not lowered
It will result in a citation
questions.explanation: Failure to stop when lights are flashing, or when a barrier is down, will result in a citation — the signals, not your own sight of the train, control.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

questions.question: You have waited for a train to clear a crossing that carries two sets of tracks. What should you do before moving off?
choices: Check for a second train on the other set of tracks
Move off as soon as the last car passes
Follow the vehicle ahead closely to clear the queue
Sound your horn to warn any approaching train
questions.explanation: Where there are two or more tracks the handbook warns you to be alert for a second train on the other set, which the first train can hide until it has passed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When there are two (2) or more tracks, you must be alert for a second train on the other set of tracks.

questions.question: Traffic is backed up beyond a railroad crossing. When may you move onto the tracks?
choices: Never, while other vehicles are on the far side
Only when the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks
As soon as the gates are up, regardless of the queue
Whenever the vehicle ahead begins to move
questions.explanation: You should not enter a crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks; otherwise you may be trapped on them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

questions.question: Why does the handbook warn against entering a crossing before you can clear it?
choices: Your vehicle may stall on the rails
The gates may damage your vehicle
You may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train
You may be fined for obstructing the railroad
questions.explanation: The stated reason is that you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train, with nowhere to go once the queue stops moving.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

questions.question: Facing a circular green signal, a driver may:
choices: Enter the intersection and go straight, turn right or turn left unless other devices prohibit it
Only go straight ahead
Only turn in the direction of the nearest arrow
Proceed without regard to right-of-way rules
questions.explanation: A circular green allows straight, right and left movements unless signs or pavement markings prohibit them, and all turns must still follow right-of-way rules.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing this signal may enter the intersection and go straight through, turn right, or left, unless, other traffi  c control devices (signs or pavement markings) prohibit certain movements.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left on a circular green and two cars are coming the other way. What must you do?
choices: Sound your horn and complete the turn
Yield to the oncoming vehicles before turning
Turn at once, because the green gives you the intersection
Wait for the signal to turn yellow, then turn
questions.explanation: A driver facing a circular green who wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles; the green permits you into the intersection but does not give you priority over them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver who is facing a circular green indication and wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

questions.question: Which statement about a circular green is NOT correct?
choices: It allows a right turn unless a sign prohibits it
Turns made on it must follow accepted right-of-way rules
It gives you the right-of-way over oncoming traffic when turning left
It allows you to enter the intersection
questions.explanation: A circular green does not give a left-turning driver priority: the handbook says that driver must yield to oncoming vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver who is facing a circular green indication and wishes to turn left must yield to oncoming vehicles.

questions.question: A green arrow means a driver may:
choices: Stop and wait for a circular green
Enter the intersection to make the movement the arrow shows
Proceed in any direction
Go only if the circular green is also lit
questions.explanation: Drivers facing a green arrow may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow, whether the arrow is shown alone or with other indications.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A green arrow may be shown alone or with other indications.  Drivers facing the signal may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

questions.question: The left-turn signal ahead of you changes to a green arrow. What does that usually tell you about oncoming traffic?
choices: It is also being given a green arrow
It must yield only if turning
It is stopped
It has the right-of-way
questions.explanation: When the green arrow is shown in a left-turn signal it usually means that opposing traffic is stopped, which is what makes the turn a protected one.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When the green arrow is shown in a left-turn signal, it usually means that opposing traffi  c is stopped.

questions.question: A steady circular yellow signal means:
choices: Proceed with caution through the intersection
Stop and remain stopped
The signal is out of order
The green light is ending and will change to red
questions.explanation: A steady circular yellow means the green is ending and will change to red; it is not a caution signal like a flashing yellow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

questions.question: The light changes to steady yellow as you approach the intersection and you are still short of it. What does the handbook direct?
choices: Do not drive through, since you are not already within the intersection
Accelerate to clear the intersection before the red
Continue at the same speed regardless
Stop only if a vehicle is waiting on the cross street
questions.explanation: You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection, so a driver still short of it should be stopping rather than speeding up.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

questions.question: Which indication tells a driver that a green arrow is about to end?
choices: A red arrow
A yellow arrow
A steady circular yellow
A flashing yellow
questions.explanation: A yellow arrow means the green arrow is ending and will change to red, just as a steady circular yellow ends a circular green.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Yellow Arrow / LEFT TURN - This means that the green arrow is ending and will change to red.

questions.question: Traffic facing a steady circular red signal must:
choices: Slow down and proceed with caution
Stop for three seconds and then continue
Stop, unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow
Stop only if cross traffic is present
questions.explanation: A steady circular red requires traffic to stop unless a green arrow permits the movement, and the driver must remain stopped until another indication allows them to proceed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

questions.question: You have stopped at a steady red. When may you proceed?
choices: After counting to five
As soon as the cross traffic clears
Whenever no pedestrians are in the crosswalk
When another signal indication allows it, or when making a permitted turn on red
questions.explanation: The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication; the only exception the handbook gives is a permitted turn on red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

questions.question: A steady red arrow points left at the signal ahead. What must you do?
choices: Come to a complete stop before the intersection, stop line or crosswalk and stay stopped while it is red
Stop, then turn left when the way is clear
Treat it as a yield and merge into a gap
Proceed if the circular signal beside it is green
questions.explanation: A steady red arrow requires a complete stop before the intersection, stop line or crosswalk for the direction indicated, and you must remain stopped as long as the signal is red.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Come to a complete stop before reaching the intersection, stop line or cross walk for the direction indicated by the arrow.  Remain stopped as long as the signal is red.

questions.question: Where signs do not prohibit it, a driver facing a red signal may turn:
choices: Right or left at any intersection
Left from any street onto a one-way street
Right only from a one-way street
Right at the intersection of two-way streets, or left from a one-way street onto another one-way street
questions.explanation: The handbook permits a right turn on red at the intersection of two-way streets, and a left on red only from a one-way street to another one-way street.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

questions.question: You want to turn right on red. What must happen before you go?
choices: A complete stop, then yielding to all other traffic and pedestrians
A slow roll while checking for traffic
Waiting for the signal to flash
Sounding the horn to warn cross traffic
questions.explanation: Turns on red may only be made after yielding to all other traffic and pedestrians, and Chapter VI adds that the driver must first come to a complete stop.

source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

questions.question: Which of these turns on red is NOT permitted by the handbook?
choices: No turn on red at all where a sign prohibits it
A left turn on red from a two-way street onto a one-way street
A right turn on red at the intersection of two-way streets
A left turn on red from a one-way street onto another one-way street
questions.explanation: A left on red is only allowed from a one-way street onto another one-way street; starting from a two-way street is not covered by the rule.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices

questions.question: At a red signal a sign reads NO TURN ON RED, but the way is completely clear. What may you do?
choices: Turn if no pedestrians are present
Treat the signal as a flashing red
Wait for the green, because the sign prohibits the turn
Turn after a complete stop, since the way is clear
questions.explanation: Turns on red may be made only if no signs are posted to prohibit them, so a posted prohibition removes the option no matter how clear the road looks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices

questions.question: A circular flashing red signal means the same as:
choices: A green light
A no-passing zone
A stop sign
A yield sign
questions.explanation: A circular flashing red is the same as a stop sign: drivers must come to a complete stop and yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A circular fl ashing red is the same as a stop sign; that is, drivers must come to

questions.question: You face a circular flashing yellow at an intersection. What are you permitted to do?
choices: Stop completely, then go
Stop and wait for a green
Yield only to traffic on your left
Proceed through the intersection with caution
questions.explanation: Drivers facing a circular flashing yellow light may proceed through the intersection with caution; only the flashing red requires a complete stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing a circular fl ashing yellow light may proceed through the intersection

questions.question: A power cut has left the signals at a junction flashing instead of cycling. How should you treat them?
choices: The same as intersection flashers
As though the intersection were uncontrolled
As a four-way green
As a closed road
questions.explanation: When signals are not needed or are out of order they may be placed in flashing operation, and the handbook says they then mean the same as intersection flashers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: When traffi  c control signals are not needed or are out of order, they may be placed in fl ashing operations. When this happens, they are the same as intersection fl ashers.

questions.question: A hand symbol or DON'T WALK signal tells pedestrians:
choices: That the signal is out of order
Not to cross the crosswalk
To cross quickly
To cross only at the far side
questions.explanation: When the hand symbol or DON'T WALK appears, pedestrians are not to cross the crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Hand Symbol or DON'T WALK- when these appear pedestrians are not to cross the crosswalk.

questions.question: Which signal tells a pedestrian it is safe to cross inside the crosswalk lines?
choices: A flashing yellow light
A green arrow
The walking man or WALK
The steady hand symbol
questions.explanation: The walking man or WALK signal means pedestrians are safe to cross the street inside the crosswalk lines; crosswalk signals are traffic signals for pedestrians and must be obeyed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Walking Man or WALK - when these appear  pedestrians are safe to cross the street inside the crosswalk lines.

questions.question: A blind person on foot using a guide dog or carrying a white cane has the right-of-way:
choices: Only when the WALK signal is showing
On a highway, street or road whether or not they are in a crosswalk
Only within a marked crosswalk
Only at signalised intersections
questions.explanation: The handbook gives a blind pedestrian using a guide dog, service animal, white cane or walking stick the right-of-way regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

questions.question: A person carrying a white cane steps into the road mid-block, well away from any crosswalk. What must you do?
choices: Sound your horn to warn them back to the kerb
Yield only if a guide dog is present
Yield, because they have the right-of-way regardless of the crosswalk
Proceed, because they are not in a crosswalk
questions.explanation: The right-of-way applies whether or not the person is in a crosswalk, and it covers a white cane or walking stick as well as a guide dog or other service animal.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

questions.question: White lines on the pavement separate:
choices: Lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions
The road from the shoulder only
Parking spaces from travel lanes only
Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction, while yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: WHITE lines separate traffic lanes moving in the SAME direction.

questions.question: You notice the line beside your lane is yellow. What does that tell you about the traffic on the other side of it?
choices: It is moving in the opposite direction
It is moving in the same direction
It is a parking lane
It is a bus-only lane
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic lanes moving in the opposite direction, which is why crossing one carries a head-on risk that crossing a white line does not.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: YELLOW lines separate traffic lanes moving in the OPPOSITE direction.

questions.question: A broken yellow line on your side of the centre line means:
choices: The lane is reversible
Traffic beside you moves the same way
You may pass when it is safe
You must not pass
questions.explanation: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions, and if the broken marking is on your side you may pass when it is safe.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.  If this marking is on your side of the road, you may pass when it is safe.

questions.question: The yellow line on your side is broken and a slow truck is ahead, but you cannot see far enough to be sure of oncoming traffic. What should you do?
choices: Pass immediately, since the marking allows it
Pass on the right instead
Sound your horn and pass
Stay behind, because the line permits a pass but does not make one safe
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means you may pass when it is safe; the marking grants permission but the judgement of safety, including sight distance, is still yours.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.  If this marking is on your side of the road, you may pass when it is safe.

questions.question: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you:
choices: Must not pass
May pass when no traffic is coming
May pass if the vehicle ahead is slow
May pass only at night
questions.explanation: The handbook is explicit: if a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

questions.question: You are halfway through passing a car when the yellow line on your side becomes solid. What does the marking mean?
choices: The solid line only applies to trucks
Sight distance has run out and you must be back in your lane
You may continue as long as the pass has begun
You may stay left until the line becomes broken again
questions.explanation: A solid yellow on your side means no passing, which is why a pass must be planned to finish before the broken line ends.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

questions.question: Where does a solid yellow line NOT mean no passing?
choices: On your side of a two-way road through a curve
On your side of a two-way road over a hill
Marking the left edge of the pavement on an interstate or divided four-lane road
On your side of a two-lane road
questions.explanation: On interstates, one-way streets and divided four-lane roads a solid yellow line marks the left edge of the pavement rather than a no-passing line.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: On interstates, one-way streets, or divided four-lane roads, a solid yellow line will mark the left edge of the pavement.

questions.question: Broken white lines on a roadway indicate:
choices: The edge of the pavement
A lane reserved for buses
Lanes moving in the same direction, which you may cross to change lanes
Lanes moving in opposite directions
questions.explanation: On roadways with more than one lane moving in one direction, the lanes are separated by broken white lines, and you drive within them, crossing only to change lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: On roadways which have more than one (1) lane moving in one direction, traffic lanes are separated by broken white lines.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT permitted where broken white lines separate lanes?
choices: Changing lanes when it is safe
Driving within your lane
Passing where no sign prohibits it
Straddling the line while travelling
questions.explanation: The handbook says to drive within these lines and never straddle them, except when actually changing lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Drive within these lines and never straddle them, except when changing lanes.

questions.question: Two lanes running the same direction are separated by a solid white line. What does it tell you?
choices: Do not change lanes
Change lanes only after signalling
Traffic beside you is oncoming
The lane ends ahead
questions.explanation: When solid white lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction, the instruction is DO NOT CHANGE LANES.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Solid white lines mark the edge of the pavement.  At night or in bad weather, they help you stay on the road.  When solid white lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction, DO NOT CHANGE LANES.

questions.question: White diamond shapes painted in a lane mean the lane is designated for:
choices: Slow-moving vehicles
Car pools, bicycles or buses
Emergency vehicles only
Left turns from either direction
questions.explanation: White diamonds painted in the roadway inform drivers that the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles or buses.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: White diamond shapes painted in the roadway to inform drivers the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles, or buses.

questions.question: Which pavement marking identifies a special purpose lane?
choices: A wide white line across the lane
Solid yellow lines on both sides
White diamond shapes painted in the lane
A double broken yellow line
questions.explanation: The white diamond is the special purpose lane marking; the double broken yellow marks a reversible lane and the wide white line across the lane is a stop line.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: White diamond shapes painted in the roadway to inform drivers the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles, or buses.

questions.question: A centre left-turn lane may be used for:
choices: Left turns from either direction
Passing slower traffic
Travelling through when your lane is busy
Parking briefly
questions.explanation: Centre left-turn lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

questions.question: Traffic in your lane is crawling and the centre lane marked for left turns is empty. May you use it to get past?
choices: Yes, provided no vehicle is waiting to turn
No — it is not to be used as a through or passing lane
Yes, if you signal first
Yes, if you re-enter your lane within 100 feet
questions.explanation: The centre left-turn lane is reserved for left turns from either direction, and traffic may be entering it head-on from the opposite side at any moment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

questions.question: How do you recognise a centre left-turn lane?
choices: A double broken yellow line on both sides
Wide white lines painted across it
Solid yellow lines nearest the through lanes with broken lines to the left of them
White diamonds painted along it
questions.explanation: You can recognise these lanes by the solid yellow lines nearest the through lanes and broken lines to the left of them; a double broken yellow on both sides would be a reversible lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

questions.question: A wide white line painted across your traffic lane marks:
choices: A pedestrian-only area
The start of a passing zone
Where you must stop your vehicle at an intersection
The edge of the pavement
questions.explanation: Stop lines are wide white lines painted across traffic lanes that mark where you must stop, keeping you clear of pedestrians and cross traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Stop Lines - Wide white lines, painted across traffic lanes, mark where you must stop your vehicle at intersections.

questions.question: There is no stop line and no crosswalk at the intersection where you must stop. Where do you stop?
choices: With your front wheels level with the kerb line of the cross street
In the intersection, to see better
Wherever the vehicle behind you allows
Before you enter the intersection, where you can see traffic from all directions
questions.explanation: With no stop lines or crosswalks you must stop before entering the intersection, and you should be able to see traffic coming from all directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: If there are no stop lines or crosswalks, you must stop your vehicle before you enter the intersections.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT correct about crosswalk markings?
choices: Every pedestrian crosswalk is marked with white lines
Many crosswalks are marked by solid white lines
Some crosswalks, especially in residential areas, are not marked
You must not block a crosswalk with your car
questions.explanation: Some crosswalks, especially in residential areas, are not marked at all, which is why the stop-sign rule refers to marked or unmarked crosswalks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Control Devices
source.sourceQuote: Many pedestrian crosswalks are marked by solid white lines. Some crosswalks, especially in residential areas, are not marked.

questions.question: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed that is:
choices: Greater than 70 mph anywhere in the state
Greater than reasonable and prudent for existing conditions
Greater than the posted limit, and nothing else
Below the flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Beyond the posted numbers, the law forbids any speed greater than is reasonable and prudent for existing conditions, so conditions can make a posted speed illegal.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed that is greater than reasonable and prudent for existing conditions.

questions.question: You are driving 55 mph on an open county highway posted at 55 when fog cuts visibility sharply. Are you within the law?
choices: Yes, provided your headlights are on
Yes, unless a lower limit is posted for fog
No, because the speed is no longer reasonable and prudent for the conditions
Yes, because you are at the posted limit
questions.explanation: The basic speed law measures your speed against existing conditions, not against the sign, so a legal number can still be an illegal speed in fog.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed that is greater than reasonable and prudent for existing conditions.

questions.question: Why does the handbook link speed to the time you have to react?
choices: Higher speeds shorten your braking distance
Speed has no effect on reaction time
Higher speeds improve your field of vision
The higher the speed, the less time you have to spot hazards and judge other vehicles
questions.explanation: The handbook explains that the higher the speed, the less time you have to spot hazards, judge the speed of other vehicles and act to avoid mistakes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: The higher the speed, the less time you have to spot hazards, judge the speed of other vehicles, and act to avoid personal mistakes and those of other drivers.

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, the maximum speed on an interstate in West Virginia is:
choices: 75 mph
70 mph
65 mph
55 mph
questions.explanation: The designated interstate limit is a maximum of 70 mph unless otherwise posted.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Interstate - Maximum Speed 70mph unless otherwise posted

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, the designated speed limit in a business or residential area is:
choices: 35 mph
45 mph
25 mph
15 mph
questions.explanation: Business and residential areas carry a designated limit of 25 mph, reflecting the number of driveways, parked cars and pedestrians there.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Business or Residential Areas - 25mph

questions.question: You are on an open county highway with no posted sign in sight. What speed applies?
choices: 70 mph
45 mph
25 mph
55 mph
questions.explanation: The designated limit for an open county highway is 55 mph unless otherwise posted.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Open County Highway - 55mph - unless otherwise posted

questions.question: Which of these designated speed limits is NOT correct?
choices: School zone with children present - 25 mph
Interstate - 70 mph maximum unless otherwise posted
Open county highway - 55 mph unless otherwise posted
Business or residential area - 25 mph
questions.explanation: A school zone is 15 mph while children are present along the roadway; 25 mph is the business and residential figure.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: School Zone (while children are present along the roadway) - 15mph

questions.question: A school zone extends how far along the street or highway from the school grounds?
choices: 500 feet
125 feet
100 feet
250 feet
questions.explanation: A school zone is all school property plus any abutting street or highway extending 125 feet along it from the school grounds.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: A school zone is all school property, including school grounds, and/or any street or highway abutting the school grounds and extending 125 feet along the street or highway from the school grounds.

questions.question: You have just passed the edge of the school grounds and the children are behind you. When does the school zone end?
choices: At the next intersection
When you can no longer see the school
125 feet along the street or highway from the school grounds
At the school property line
questions.explanation: The zone includes the abutting street or highway for 125 feet beyond the school grounds, so the restriction continues past the property line.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: A school zone is all school property, including school grounds, and/or any street or highway abutting the school grounds and extending 125 feet along the street or highway from the school grounds.

questions.question: How far before a turn must you signal?
choices: At least 500 feet
At least 100 feet
At least 50 feet
At least 200 feet
questions.explanation: The handbook says to signal at least 100 feet before you plan to turn, and to get into the habit of signalling every time you make a change.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Get into the habit of signaling every time you make a change.  Signal at least 100 feet before you plan to turn.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT require a turn signal?
choices: Pulling away from the curb
Entering or leaving an interstate
Coming to a stop in your own lane in slow traffic
Changing lanes
questions.explanation: The handbook lists changing lanes, turning at an intersection, entering or leaving an interstate, pulling away from the curb and pulling over as the moves needing a signal.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Other drivers expect you to continue traveling in the same direction.  By using your turn signals, you let them know that you intend to turn or change lanes.

questions.question: You intend to turn at the second street, just beyond the intersection ahead. When should you signal?
choices: As early as possible, to give maximum warning
Only after you have crossed the first intersection and begun the turn
Signalling is optional beyond an intersection
Not so soon that drivers think you are turning at the first intersection
questions.explanation: Signalling too soon makes drivers at the first intersection think you are turning there and pull into your path, while signalling too late leaves those behind you no time to react.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If you plan to turn beyond an intersection, do not confuse other drivers by signaling too soon.

questions.question: The handbook's rule about speed and turning is to:
choices: Coast into the turn and brake at its midpoint
Slow down before making the turn and not brake while turning
Brake steadily throughout the turn
Accelerate through the turn to stay stable
questions.explanation: Slowing before the turn and not braking while turning keeps the vehicle settled; braking mid-turn shifts weight and reduces grip exactly when you need it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Slow down before making turns.  Do not brake while turning.

questions.question: You complete a right turn into a two-lane road. Which lane should you end up in?
choices: The left lane, so you can pass sooner
Either lane, as long as you signal
The proper lane, which is the nearest lane to the right
Whichever lane is emptier
questions.explanation: The rule is to always finish turning in the proper lane; drifting into the far lane crosses the path of traffic that expects you to stay right.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Always fi nish turning in the proper lane.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the handbook's rules for turns?
choices: Prepare for the turn rather than deciding at the last moment
Check traffic to the front and rear and watch for pedestrians
Check the blind spot by glancing over the proper shoulder
Decide whether to turn at the last moment so you keep your options open
questions.explanation: The handbook says to prepare for the turn and not make decisions to turn at the last moment, so deliberately leaving the decision late is the one option it contradicts.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Before entering the turning lane, signal, look in the mirrors, and check the blind spot by glancing over the proper shoulder.

questions.question: While waiting in an intersection to make a left turn, your front wheels should be:
choices: Turned hard left against the kerb
Pointed straight ahead
Turned to the left, ready for the turn
Turned slightly right
questions.explanation: The handbook says not to turn the wheels to the left while waiting, because a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When waiting to turn left, do not turn the wheels to the left.  Otherwise, a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffi  c.

questions.question: Why does it matter which way your wheels point while you wait to turn left?
choices: Angled wheels make the turn slower to complete
Angled wheels obscure your view of oncoming traffic
If you are hit from behind, angled wheels send you into oncoming traffic
Angled wheels wear the tyres unevenly
questions.explanation: A bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffic if the wheels are already turned left; straight wheels send you forward into the intersection instead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When waiting to turn left, do not turn the wheels to the left.  Otherwise, a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffi  c.

questions.question: It is against the law to turn your vehicle around near the crest of a hill unless you can be seen by a vehicle approaching within:
choices: 500 feet in either direction
100 feet in either direction
200 feet in either direction
1,000 feet in either direction
questions.explanation: A turnaround is illegal near a curve or hill crest where you cannot be seen by another vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: it is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve, near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by another vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs  prohibit turning.

questions.question: You have missed your turn and the only wide spot is just over the brow of a hill. What does the law require?
choices: Reverse back over the crest instead
Do not turn around there, because approaching drivers cannot see you in time
Turn around quickly while no vehicle is visible
Turn around with your hazard lights on
questions.explanation: Turning around near the crest of a hill where an approaching vehicle within 500 feet could not see you is against the law, and hazard lights do not change that.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: it is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve, near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by another vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs  prohibit turning.

questions.question: Before backing up, you should:
choices: Check completely around the vehicle for people and other obstacles
Check the rear view mirror only
Rely on the reversing camera alone
Sound the horn and reverse slowly
questions.explanation: The handbook says to check completely around your vehicle for people and obstacles, look front, sides and rear, and keep looking to the rear while backing rather than depending on the mirror.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Before backing, check completely around your vehicle for people and/or other obstacles.  You should look to the front, sides and rear and continue to look to the rear while backing. Do not depend on your mirror.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT acceptable according to the handbook?
choices: Backing slowly into the proper traffic lane
Backing across other traffic lanes or through an intersection
Backing into a parallel parking space
Looking to the rear while backing
questions.explanation: You must never back across other traffic lanes or through an intersection; backing into a parallel parking space is the stated exception to backing in a traffic lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: It is not advisable to back up while in a traffi  c lane, except for backing into a parallel parking space.  Never back across other traffi  c lanes or through an intersection.

questions.question: You are reversing out of a residential driveway. What does the handbook single out as the special risk?
choices: Traffic signals you cannot see
Your mirrors misting up
Children who may have run behind the vehicle
Damage to the kerb
questions.explanation: Drivers are told to be extra watchful when backing in or out of a driveway for children who may have run behind the vehicle, where no mirror will show them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: As a driver, be extra careful in residential areas, school zones and at times and places where children are likely to be around.

questions.question: Vehicles must always be parked:
choices: Facing the same direction as traffic moves on that side of the street
Facing oncoming traffic so you can see it
At any angle, provided the vehicle is off the travelled portion
Facing downhill where possible
questions.explanation: Parking in the direction traffic moves on that side of the street means you enter and leave the space without crossing into opposing traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Vehicles must always be parked in the same direction as the movement of traffi  c on that side of the street.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT required when you park and leave your vehicle?
choices: Locking the vehicle and taking your keys
Leaving the engine running if you will only be a moment
Turning off the engine
Setting the parking or emergency brake
questions.explanation: The handbook requires the engine off and the parking brake set whenever you park and leave the vehicle, and adds that you should lock it and take your keys.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Whenever you park and leave your vehicle, you must turn off  the engine and set the parking (emergency) brake.

questions.question: You are about to open your door into the street after parking. What does the handbook warn about?
choices: You must never exit on the street side under any circumstances
Opening the door releases the parking brake
Bicycles, motorcycles or larger vehicles passing may not see your door in time
The door may trigger the alarm
questions.explanation: Getting out on the street side can be dangerous because passing bicycles, motorcycles or larger vehicles may not see you in time to avoid hitting your open door, or you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Getting out of your vehicle on the street side can be dangerous. Always look carefully  for bicycles, motorcycles, or larger vehicles that might be passing. The drivers may not see you in time to keep from hitting your open door, or you.

questions.subtopic: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)
questions.question: How close to a fire hydrant may you park?
choices: No closer than 30 feet
No closer than 15 feet
No closer than 10 feet
No closer than 20 feet
questions.explanation: Stopping, standing or parking is prohibited within 15 feet of a fire hydrant so that crews can reach it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)

questions.subtopic: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)
questions.question: Parking is prohibited within how many feet of a stop sign or traffic control signal?
choices: 20 feet
50 feet
30 feet
15 feet
questions.explanation: The prohibited distance is 30 feet from any stop sign or traffic control signal, which keeps the sign visible to approaching drivers.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

questions.question: Which prohibited parking distance applies to the nearest rail of a railroad crossing?
choices: 30 feet
20 feet
15 feet
50 feet
questions.explanation: Parking is not allowed within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing, the largest of the listed distances.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

questions.question: You find a kerbside space that is 18 feet from a crosswalk at an intersection. May you park there?
choices: No, because parking is prohibited within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection
Yes, because the limit is 15 feet
Yes, if you are within the vehicle
Yes, if no crosswalk lines are painted
questions.explanation: The prohibited distance is 20 feet from a crosswalk at an intersection, so 18 feet is inside it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

questions.subtopic: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)
questions.question: Which of these locations is NOT on the handbook's prohibited parking list?
choices: Within 20 feet of a mailbox served by a carrier using a motor vehicle
A kerb painted white outside a shop
Upon any bridge or elevated structure or in a highway tunnel
In front of a wheelchair ramp or curb cut
questions.explanation: The listed prohibitions include bridges and tunnels, wheelchair ramps and curb cuts, and 20 feet from a served mailbox; the handbook notes a no-parking kerb may be painted yellow, not white.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 2022, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
